title: Archive Spell 3: When the file is missing
lessonSummary: Well done! You catch FileNotFoundError and check with os whether a file exists.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: a missing file, exists and remove.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import os
try:
    with open("missing.txt", "r") as f:
        print(f.read())
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Error: file missing")
with open("quest_log.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("Pyralia Quest Log\n")
print("Exists:", os.path.exists("quest_log.txt"))
os.remove("quest_log.txt")
print("Afterwards:", os.path.exists("quest_log.txt"))

title: Archive Spell 6: CSV tables: writer and reader
lessonSummary: Masterful! You write and read tables in CSV format.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: write CSV, read it and calculate.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import csv
with open("heroes.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["name", "level"])
    w.writerow(["Aria", 15])
    w.writerow(["Thorin", 18])
    w.writerow(["Luna", 12])
total = 0
with open("heroes.csv", "r") as f:
    r = csv.reader(f)
    next(r)
    for row in r:
        total += int(row[1])
print("Total:", total)

title: Archive Spell 7: CSV with DictReader and switching formats
lessonSummary: World class! You read tables as dictionaries and convert between JSON and CSV.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: DictWriter and DictReader.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import csv
heroes = [
    {"name": "Aria", "class": "Mage", "level": 15, "hp": 120},
    {"name": "Thorin", "class": "Warrior", "level": 18, "hp": 150},
    {"name": "Luna", "class": "Rogue", "level": 12, "hp": 90},
]
with open("heroes.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["name", "class", "level", "hp"])

    w.writerows(heroes)
with open("heroes.csv", "r") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
print("Rows:", len(rows))
print("First:", rows[0]["name"])
